# sqlite

`node:sqlite`-shaped API over the `mochinode_sqlite` engine plugin
(`mochi_modules/mochinode_sqlite.dll`), which talks to the system SQLite
library (libsqlite3 / sqlite3.dll) through prepared statements.

## Usage

```js
import { open, version } from './node_modules/sqlite/index.js';

const db = open('app.db');
db.run('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT)');
db.run("INSERT INTO items(title) VALUES ('hello')");

console.log(db.all('SELECT * FROM items'));
console.log(db.get('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM items'));
```

## API

| member | description |
|--------|-------------|
| `open(path)` | open a database (`:memory:` works), returns a handle |
| `db.run(sql)` | execute a statement, throws on error |
| `db.all(sql)` | run a query, returns an array of row objects |
| `db.get(sql)` | first row or `undefined` |
| `db.close()` | close the database |
| `version()` | SQLite library version string |

Values are typed through `sqlite3_column_type`: INTEGER → number,
FLOAT → number, TEXT → string, NULL/BLOB → `null`.

> Bind parameters are not wired up yet — values are interpolated by the
> caller in the demo app.
